name: Match cut
visual_intent: Visual continuity across a cut: the incoming element starts exactly where a similar outgoing element was, then settles.
implementation_summary: Measures layout boxes, cuts scenes, tweens the incoming element from the outgoing box to its own.
runtime_api: Studio.fx.matchCut(tl, fromEl, toEl, outScene, inScene, at, {duration})

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test tests/test-studio-runtime.py and frame review of projects/masala-chai-recipe (landscape, portrait, square) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the Apple M2 host, so not approved.
